title: Role swap is an involution
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol with Alice's inputs drawn from a type $X$, Bob's from a type $Y$, and outputs in a type $\alpha$. Applying the role swap twice — first exchanging the roles of Alice and Bob throughout $p$, then exchanging them again — returns the original protocol $p$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: p is a protocol over input types X (Alice) and Y (Bob) with outputs in α
replaced:
Swapping Alice and Bob twice recovers the original protocol: for any $p$ over $X \times Y$,
$p.\texttt{swap}.\texttt{swap} = p$.
